validation_cases.acceptance: A changed input or code dependency invalidates downstream results; an absent required input fails before analysis.
Non-ASCII fields work under UTF-8 and C locales; import warnings, silent truncation and missing required columns fail.
Unexpected duplicate child/visit keys and many-to-many joins fail or follow a documented reviewed aggregation rule.
A measurement immediately before diagnosis stays pre-TB; same-day and later measurements follow the selected inclusive rule.
Test exactly1 and5 years at diagnosis; nominal visits, exact-age limits, study exit and administrative cutoffs are separate explicit rules.
Missing one bronchodilator stage excludes a paired measurement without excluding valid unpaired outcomes.
Test LLN equality versus strictly below, mixed low-ratio/low-FVC patterns, unit transforms and adverse-direction signs.
Contacts30days apart remain one episode,31days apart split; chained contacts use consecutive gaps; scheduled assessments are never episode contacts.
Nonpositive values do not enter the log analysis; main and supplementary timing comparators are checked separately.
Carry-forward stops at the earliest next observation, two-year limit, TB event or censoring; no post-TB measurement enters the predictor.
All aggregate counts remain exact; zero-event/nonestimable coefficients receive an explicit status without fabricated estimates.
RR, conditional OR, IRR, GMR and mean differences remain distinct; native versus z-score outputs cannot be swapped.
Test discovery fails when zero tests or source files are found; deliberate malformed fixtures demonstrate that checks reject errors.
Two execution modes validate their own prerequisites; figures retain estimates and embedded Arial; tables/prose share one rounding policy.

comparison_policy.deterministic: Exact row membership, keys, counts and classifications; declared scale-specific tolerances for floating-point transforms and deterministic fits, fixed before comparison.
comparison_policy.stochastic: Verify same model/sample first; specify convergence, Monte Carlo error and posterior-summary tolerances before new fits. Matching rounded values alone is insufficient; bitwise posterior identity is not required.
comparison_policy.reporting: Check full-precision source estimates and each displayed rounded scientific value; investigate discrepancies without changing targets to force a pass.
comparison_policy.failure: Any unresolved required input, estimand, diagnostic or output mismatch blocks the affected module and final release; independent unaffected modules can progress.

execution_contract.current: M01-M14 are independently validated, including 868 tests, final original/copied cumulative replays, all 304 cell classifications, 261 scientific table cells, 42 sentences and nine figures with inspected embedded Arial. M15 implements --full, --render --render-config FILE and reviewed source export; final clean-run/package/remote evidence is bound separately. Four upstream flow counts and the combined loss fact remain explicitly unavailable.
execution_contract.full: Reconstruct preparation, all deterministic models, all 37 joint fits and M13/M14 publications from authorized inputs using absent/empty separated roots. Bind paired origin records to source, inputs, nine configurations, runtime, fonts/references and destination paths. Verify unchanged diagnostic gates, final receipts and independent frozen scientific comparisons. Full command success does not establish GitHub delivery.
execution_contract.render: Verify trusted accepted M13/M14 receipt SHA-256 values and complete aggregate inventories; require exact reconstructed scientific table/prose/plot payloads. Permit compatible renderer presentation/runtime changes under a separate identity. Load no study inputs or raw posteriors, fit no models and perform no analytical revalidation; retain the accepted Figure S3 correction unchanged.
execution_contract.restart: Cumulative --through M14 --resume revalidates existing artifacts and preserves raw Bayesian identities. --full --resume additionally requires matching paired clean-origin records and unchanged source/input/configuration/runtime/destination identity; arbitrary old caches cannot be adopted. Aggregate-only --render --resume regenerates and compares complete rendered payloads from the same trusted source publications. Locks, staging, atomic publication and complete file hashes apply; source-package and remote verification remain separate.
